questions.text: Describe a complex UI component you've built. How did you approach state management and performance optimization?

follow_up_suggestions.text: Can you be more specific about the component structure and the libraries you used?
How did you handle re-renders and what optimization techniques did you apply?

scoring_rubric.1: Cannot describe a relevant component or lacks understanding of state management
scoring_rubric.2: Describes a component but with significant gaps in approach
scoring_rubric.3: Describes a moderately complex component with reasonable solutions
scoring_rubric.4: Demonstrates strong understanding of state management and performance
scoring_rubric.5: Exceptional understanding with sophisticated optimization strategies

questions.text: How do you approach responsive design and testing across different screen sizes?

follow_up_suggestions.text: What specific tools or approaches do you use for responsive testing?

scoring_rubric.2: Basic knowledge of media queries but missing broader context
scoring_rubric.3: Good understanding of responsive design with testing approach
scoring_rubric.4: Comprehensive approach including mobile-first design and testing
scoring_rubric.5: Expert understanding with sophisticated responsive design patterns

questions.text: Tell me about your experience with testing frontend code. What testing frameworks and strategies have you used?

follow_up_suggestions.text: What's your approach to testing user interactions and edge cases?

scoring_rubric.2: Basic testing knowledge but incomplete coverage
scoring_rubric.3: Good understanding of unit and integration testing
scoring_rubric.4: Comprehensive testing approach including E2E tests
scoring_rubric.5: Expert understanding with sophisticated testing strategies

questions.text: How do you approach debugging performance issues in a frontend application?

follow_up_suggestions.text: What specific tools do you use to identify and measure performance problems?

scoring_rubric.2: Basic debugging but missing systematic methodology
scoring_rubric.3: Systematic debugging approach with browser tools
scoring_rubric.5: Expert debugging with advanced profiling techniques
